metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from the agent-skills repository

plugins.name: agent-tasks-hooks
plugins.description: Emits lifecycle hook events for the Agent Tasks VS Code extension Sessions panel

plugins.name: pr-relevance-memory
plugins.description: GitHub Actions reusable workflow that records PR comment resolution signals into LoreKit, making the reviewer and pr-reviewer agents continuously more accurate per repository. Install the caller template (templates/pr-relevance-caller.yml) and add LOREKIT_API_KEY to your repo secrets.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer-shape-guard
plugins.description: GitHub Actions reusable workflow that validates a POSTED pr-reviewer report body against the report shape contract, from outside the agent — the only guard that sees what actually reached a PR. Install the caller template (templates/report-shape-caller.yml); no secrets required.
